consultations.raw_input: My mustard crop has aphid infestation and leaf curl. Please suggest low cost treatment under ₹300.

ai_response.summary: Integrated Pest & Soil Management Strategy: Sustainable, low-cost bio-control plan for crop health.

steps.rationale: Apply 5ml Neem Oil (10,000 PPM) + 1ml liquid soap per liter of water at evening time. This deters sucking pests and aphid colonies without killing beneficial predator insects.
Install 6-8 yellow sticky cards per bigha/acre to monitor and trap whiteflies and thrips before they transmit leaf curl viral diseases. Cost is under ₹100.

steps.action: Soil Trichoderma Viride Inoculation with Farmyard Manure
steps.rationale: Mix 1kg Trichoderma with 50kg well-decomposed cow dung manure to suppress root rot and fungal wilt pathogens biologically.

scam_reports.suspect_identifier: Dear customer your electricity power will be disconnected at 9:30 PM due to unpaid bill. Call officer immediately.

analysis_details.explanation: This message uses urgent fear tactics and impersonation. Legitimate banks, DISCOMs, or government agencies NEVER ask you to download unknown APK files, click unverified bit.ly links, or share 6-digit OTPs.
analysis_details.immediate_action: DO NOT click any link, share OTP, or send even ₹1 for 'verification'. Block the caller/sender immediately. Call 1930 if money was debited.
